name: Osteoclast lineage development via M-CSF signaling
rationale: All members concern macrophage/osteoclast proliferation, fusion, differentiation and bone resorption or the CSF1/interleukin receptor signaling driving them; M-CSF signaling separates it from monocyte/DC differentiation (GM-CSF) and DAP12/syncytium confusables.

name: Platelet activation via soluble-agonist GPCRs
rationale: Every member is platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation or coagulation; ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling distinguish it from adhesion- and integrin-centred platelet confusables.

name: Convergent extension via planar cell polarity
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and the convergent extension movements it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate shaping, unlike confusables centred on axial mesoderm patterning or non-canonical Wnt receptor internalization.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of adenylate cyclase through inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenoceptors, distinguishing it from cAMP/PKA-activation, adrenergic-secretion and muscarinic/purinergic Gi confusables.

name: Regulation of NK and cytotoxic T cell killing
rationale: Members are NK cell receptor signatures, MHC class I-recognising lymphoid interactions and positive/negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, while confusables add KIR clusters, granzyme death or T cell proliferation instead of T cell cytotoxicity control.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are mesenchyme-driven morphogenesis of face, nose, palate, neurocranium, viscerocranium, digits and limbs, unlike confusables covering pharyngeal-derived glands or bone/cartilage ossification.

name: Fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members concern integrin-based focal adhesion, fibronectin matrix formation, SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration; the fibroblast/TGFB-collagen context separates it from syndecan, MET and smooth-muscle adhesion confusables.

core: Negative control of skeletal muscle mass
name: Negative control of skeletal muscle mass
rationale: Members are muscle atrophy, inactivity responses, SCF-ubiquitin catabolism, satellite cell maintenance and inhibition of myoblast and myotube differentiation, opposite to the growth, hypertrophy and contraction confusables.

name: Recombination-dependent telomere maintenance
rationale: Members are telomere recombination, break-induced replication, D-loop and t-circle handling and their checkpoints, distinguishing it from confusables focused on general repair, telomere C-strand synthesis or recombination inhibition.

name: cAMP signaling through PKA activation
rationale: All members concern GPCR/forskolin-driven cAMP synthesis and PKA activation; PKA activation separates it from CREB-, phosphodiesterase- and adenylate-cyclase-inhibition confusables.

name: COPI-mediated vesicle traffic between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members are COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, contrasting with COPII export and SRP/ER insertion confusables.

name: Kidney development with nephron tubule differentiation
rationale: Members span nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric nephron development; nephron tubule segment formation and epithelial differentiation distinguish it from ureteric bud induction confusables.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
name: Plasma membrane delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome-to-plasma membrane and Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport and endosome organization, unlike confusables centred on constitutive secretion or endosome-to-Golgi retrieval.

name: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitors restraining differentiation
rationale: Members are progenitor transcription programmes (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis TFs), progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, while confusables carry positive differentiation and mature lineage terms.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK cascade regulation including oncogenic RAF mutants
rationale: Members are RAF activation, MAP2K/ERK activation, ERK inactivation and feedback, with BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K mutants and fusions distinguishing it from RAS GAP and SOS/RIT confusables.

name: Vitamin K and C metabolism including gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation plus ascorbate metabolism and transport; gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate separate it from vitamin D, E, quinone and oxygen-transport confusables.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production via STING
rationale: Members regulate DC cytokine, CCL5 and STAT6-induced chemokine production, with cGAMP import/cGAS-STING enhancement distinguishing it from chemokine and Th1-cytokine confusables.

name: Noncoding RNA methylation and small RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and cap methylation plus snRNP/snoRNP assembly and Cajal body RNA localisation, unlike pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translation control
name: Post-transcriptional mRNA control in cytoplasmic stress granules
rationale: Members concern RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability, localisation and translation together with stress granule dynamics and PKR/arsenite stress, while confusables emphasise TTP/KSRP-driven decay and decapping.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation in developing cartilage and joints
rationale: Members regulate chondroblast and chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis, unlike ossification, tendon and articular cartilage homeostasis confusables.

name: Beta cell insulin secretion via K-ATP channel coupling
rationale: Members are nutrient, incretin, fatty acid and neural regulation of insulin secretion and processing in beta cells; K-ATP channel members distinguish it from insulin-action, GLUT4 and insulin receptor signaling confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome turnover with linkage-specific chain editing
rationale: Members are ubiquitination of diverse chain linkages, deubiquitinases, E1/E2 enzymes and proteasome assembly and degradation, contrasting with neddylation/COP9 and ERAD/autophagy quality-control confusables.

name: Rab-regulated Golgi organization and retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon and stack organization, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, vesicle tethering and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation, with Rab GEFs and geranylgeranylation distinguishing it from TGN-endosome-lysosome and COPII confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are general L-amino acid metabolic terms plus proline biosynthesis and catabolism, distinguishing it from serine/glycine and organic acid confusables.

name: Vitamin A uptake and conversion to retinoic acid
rationale: Members cover retinol/retinal/retinoic acid metabolism and transport including STRA6 uptake defects, separating it from the visual retinoid cycle, retinoic acid response and vitamin D confusables.

name: Telomere end protection restraining recombination and telomerase
rationale: Members are telomere capping, end packaging, protein localization to telomeres and inhibition of telomeric recombination, NHEJ and telomerase, unlike confusables centred on telomere replication or telomerase extension.

name: Energy-carrier nucleotide and phosphagen metabolism with NAD salvage
rationale: Members are phosphocreatine, NDP/NTP interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and NAD/NADP synthesis and salvage, combining what PRPP, mitochondrial-apoptosis and nucleotide-kinase confusables each only partly cover.

name: Telomere maintenance with Cajal body telomerase trafficking
rationale: Members span telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination, capping and senescence; telomerase RNA/scaRNA trafficking to Cajal bodies distinguishes it from broad DNA repair and chromatin confusables.

name: Inflammatory cytokine regulation via TLR2/4 and NLRP inflammasomes
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4 bacterial ligand sensing, NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine output, distinguishing it from pyroptosis/non-canonical inflammasome and TRIF/IFN confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members are beta-catenin/TCF target activation and AXIN/APC destruction-complex stability defects, distinguishing it from confusables about DVL activation, ligand antagonists and target repression.
